Topic: The Geometric Relationship: Sphere Surface Area and Projected Shadow

Target audience: High school geometry students

Section: section_1 — Prerequisite Review: The Circle and the Sphere

Lecture lines:
A circle's area is πr². [Asset: circle_anim]
A sphere is points equidistant from center. [Asset: sphere_anim]
Cutting a sphere creates a circular cross-section. [Asset: cross_section_anim]

Planned animations:
Draw a circle in #FFD700.
Fill the circle with #4169E1 opacity 0.5.
Display the radius r in #FFFFFF.

Section: section_2 — The Geometry of the Projected Shadow

Lecture lines:
Parallel rays create a cylindrical shadow. [Asset: parallel_rays_anim]
The sphere's shadow is a circle of radius r. [Asset: shadow_circle_anim]
The shadow's area is exactly πr². [Asset: shadow_area_anim]

Planned animations:
Draw a sphere in #FFD700.
Rotate the sphere to show volume.
Project a circle shadow in #808080.

Section: section_3 — Deriving the Sphere Surface Area

Lecture lines:
Archimedes discovered a remarkable geometric truth. [Asset: archimedes_intro_anim]
A sphere's surface is 4 times its shadow. [Asset: surface_shadow_comparison_anim]
Four circular shadows cover the sphere exactly. [Asset: four_shadows_tiling_anim]
The total surface area is 4πr². [Asset: formula_reveal_anim]
This elegant ratio defines spherical geometry. [Asset: summary_anim]

Planned animations:
Show thin rings on the sphere.
Unfold rings into flat strips.
Sum the areas using #32CD32 rectangles.

Section: section_4 — Practical Application: Calculating Solar Heat Gain

Lecture lines:
Satellites receive solar radiation in space. [Asset: satellite_sun_anim]
Only the shadow area intercepts solar heat. [Asset: heat_interception_anim]
Heat spreads over the entire surface area. [Asset: heat_distribution_anim]

Planned animations:
Show a sphere receiving sunlight rays.
Highlight the projected circular cross-section.
Calculate area with #FF4500 formula.

Section: section_5 — Summary and Quick Check

Lecture lines:
Shadow area is πr². [Asset: recap_shadow_anim]
Surface area is 4πr². [Asset: recap_surface_anim]
The surface is 4 times the shadow. [Asset: summary_ratio_anim]

Planned animations:
Flash the sphere and circle symbols.
Show summary text in #FFFFFF.
Fade out all elements slowly.

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE

        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):

                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):

        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]

        return mobject

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject
